description: This file defines the Mutator class which manages server state changes, undo/redo operations, and interactions with external APIs for a project related to board and card management, including operations like creating, updating, duplicating, and deleting boards, cards, and properties.

classes.name: Mutator
classes.description: A class that manages all server state modifications, undo/redo operations, and interactions with external APIs for boards, cards, properties, views, categories, and user configurations.

methods.name: updateAllBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Updates the Redux store with filtered boards and blocks based on their type and delete status.

methods.name: beginUndoGroup
methods.description: Starts a new undo group, ensuring no nested groups are created.

methods.name: endUndoGroup
methods.description: Ends the current undo group, verifying group consistency.

methods.name: performAsUndoGroup
methods.description: Executes a set of actions within an undo group context.

methods.name: updateBlock
methods.description: Updates a specific block on the server and manages undo/redo.

methods.name: updateBlocks
methods.description: Batch updates multiple blocks with undo/redo support.

methods.name: insertBlock
methods.description: Inserts a new block on the server with undo/redo capabilities.

methods.name: insertBlocks
methods.description: Inserts multiple blocks with undo/redo support.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a block with undo/redo support.

methods.name: createBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Creates new boards and blocks with undo/redo support.

methods.name: updateBoard
methods.description: Updates a board with undo/redo support.

methods.name: deleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a board with undo/redo support.

methods.name: changeBlockTitle
methods.description: Changes the title of a block with undo/redo support.

methods.name: changeBoardTitle
methods.description: Changes the title of a board with undo/redo support.

methods.name: setDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Sets the default template for a block with undo support.

methods.name: clearDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Clears the default template for a block with undo support.

methods.name: changeBoardIcon
methods.description: Changes the icon of a board with undo support.

methods.name: changeBlockIcon
methods.description: Changes the icon of a block with undo support.

methods.name: changeBoardDescription

methods.name: showBoardDescription

methods.name: changeCardContentOrder

methods.name: createBoardMember
methods.description: Creates a new board member with undo support.

methods.name: updateBoardMember

methods.name: deleteBoardMember
methods.description: Deletes a board member with undo support.

methods.name: insertPropertyTemplate

methods.name: duplicatePropertyTemplate

methods.name: changePropertyTemplateOrder

methods.name: deleteProperty

methods.name: updateBoardCardProperties

methods.name: insertPropertyOption

methods.name: deletePropertyOption

methods.name: changePropertyOptionOrder

methods.name: changePropertyOptionValue

methods.name: changePropertyOptionColor
methods.description: Changes the color of a property option with undo support.

methods.name: changePropertyValue
methods.description: Updates a property value on a card with undo support.

methods.name: changePropertyTypeAndName
methods.description: Changes the type and name of a property template, updating related cards and views with undo support.

methods.name: changeViewSortOptions
methods.description: Updates the sort options of a view with undo support.

methods.name: changeViewFilter

methods.name: changeViewGroupById

methods.name: changeViewDateDisplayPropertyId

methods.name: changeViewVisiblePropertiesOrder
